sehemu: Part V: Court of Appeal of the United Republic
jina: Tenure of office of Justices of Appeal
maudhui: (1) Every Justice of Appeal shall vacate office on attaining the age of sixty-five years, subject to the following provisions of this Article. (2) A Justice of Appeal may retire from office at any time after attaining the age of sixty years, unless the President directs that the Justice shall not retire, in which case the Justice concerned shall not be entitled to retire until the period specified by the President has expired. (3) Where the President considers it to be in the public interest for a Justice of Appeal who has attained the age of sixty-five years to continue in office, and that Justice agrees in writing to continue in office, the President may direct that the Justice continue in office for such period as the President may specify. (4) Notwithstanding that a Justice of Appeal has attained the age at which he is required to vacate office under this Article, a person holding office as a Justice of Appeal may continue in office after attaining that age until he has completed preparing and delivering judgment.
vifungu: (1) Every Justice of Appeal shall vacate office on attaining the age of sixty-five years, subject to the following provisions of this Article.

(2) A Justice of Appeal may retire from office at any time after attaining the age of sixty years, unless the President directs that the Justice shall not retire, in which case the Justice concerned shall not be entitled to retire until the period specified by the President has expired.

(3) Where the President considers it to be in the public interest for a Justice of Appeal who has attained the age of sixty-five years to continue in office, and that Justice agrees in writing to continue in office, the President may direct that the Justice continue in office for such period as the President may specify.

(4) Notwithstanding that a Justice of Appeal has attained the age at which he is required to vacate office under this Article, a person holding office as a Justice of Appeal may continue in office after attaining that age until he has completed preparing and delivering judgment.
